scope.primary_version: V5 latest completed full SCRIPT cohort
scope.comparison_note: Same fixed development cohort, same Qwen weights and released captions. SCRIPT additionally reads video; no held-out causal/generalization claim.

option_numbering.method: Normalized text compared with same-length option prefixes using SequenceMatcher; best score >=0.9 and margin >=0.15. Heuristic identifies examples, not an exhaustive semantic classification.

sufficiency.note: Answer-choice correctness is not an independently annotated evidence-sufficiency judgment; stop groups were not randomized.

observation_option_copy.method: Case/punctuation-normalized equality, or candidate length >80 and equal to option prefix. Copying text does not itself prove a perception error.

limitations: Uses V5 observations and captions, including any V5 fact loss or observation errors.
Only final decision code/prompt changes; does not measure new observation/verification behavior.
Answer-stage timing is not end-to-end SCRIPT latency.
Same 100 development questions; not held-out accuracy.

existing_gpu_smoke.scope: Selected development diagnostics within the fixed 100 questions; not an accuracy estimate.

v6b.smoke_accuracy: 1/4 selected diagnostics; not a population estimate
implemented_repairs: semantic description included in other-claim deduplication
final answer can override gate candidate

recommended_next_experiments.experiment: Use explicit option IDs plus deterministic answer text from selected option; rerun fixed-evidence decisions with and without forced gate choice.
recommended_next_experiments.purpose: Separate option mapping/locking failures from upstream evidence quality.

recommended_next_experiments.experiment: Retain atomic concrete actions, semantic claim identities and separate observation from purpose inference; reject unsupported activity claims on unusable frames.
recommended_next_experiments.purpose: Prevent lost alternatives and hallucinated observations from entering trusted state.

recommended_next_experiments.experiment: For global questions, form full-timeline answer hypotheses first, then inspect only the action/object/temporal distinction that can change the selected option.
recommended_next_experiments.purpose: Reduce repeated global-question observations and preserve discriminating option tails.

recommended_next_experiments.experiment: Compare caption-only QA, caption plus observations without gate locking, and full SCRIPT on exactly the same frozen cohort/configuration.
recommended_next_experiments.purpose: Measure incremental value/cost of observation, verification and stopping mechanisms before scaling.

method_limits: No new model inference or GPU benchmark was performed in this analysis.
Saved V6b recheck changes several final-decision details simultaneously and is not a one-variable ablation.
Cases and mechanism counts overlap and must not be summed into a percentage attribution of 50 wrong answers.
No exhaustive independent video annotations were created.
